odc_type: IndexOutOfBoundsException due to improper boundary checking
observation_summary: The application throws a java.lang.StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when processing incomplete or malformed HTML entities.
reasoning_summary: The code attempted to access characters in a CharSequence using index-based lookups without verifying if the index was within the bounds of the string. Specifically, the loop condition 'input.charAt(end) != ';'' assumed that a semicolon would always be present before the end of the string, leading to an out-of-bounds access when the input string ended prematurely (e.g., '&#03'). The fix introduced explicit boundary checks (end < seqEnd) and replaced the unsafe character lookup with a validation loop that checks for valid numeric/hexadecimal characters, preventing the code from reading past the end of the input.
